scene_description: A flat grass platform with a prominent gray terracotta tower/structure 10 blocks ahead of spawn, marked with torches and a lantern. Gray terracotta path blocks on the ground guide the player toward the structure. Adjacent to the structure (to the right/east side) are granite blocks for mining, and a crafting table for crafting the stone_axe. The player starts with cobblestone (3), sticks (2), and a wooden pickaxe.
task_text: Find the gray terracotta structure ahead, mine the granite blocks next to it, then use the crafting table to craft a stone axe from the cobblestone and sticks in your inventory.
